How to Use DropPeer

Direct browser-to-browser file and clipboard sharing in seconds — no accounts, no cloud uploads, no setup.

How It Works

STEP 01

Create a Room

Click "Create Room" on the home page to generate a unique 12-character room code.

STEP 02

Connect Your Second Device

Scan the QR code with your phone or open the room link on another computer.

STEP 03

Verify the 4 Safety Emojis

Once connected, confirm the 4 emojis in the header match on both screens to guarantee an unspoofed, end-to-end encrypted connection.

STEP 04

Drop Files or Text

Drag and drop files or paste text into the shared clipboard for instant direct transfer.

What You Can Do

  • Send multiple files of any type (photos, PDFs, ZIPs, videos) directly between devices with live speed and progress tracking.
  • Share links and text snippets instantly via the live Shared Clipboard.
  • Transfer across the same Wi-Fi (fastest, stays on your local router) or across different internet networks.
  • Rely on automatic end-to-end encryption (DTLS) and SHA-256 file integrity verification.

What You Can't Do & Limitations

  • No Cloud Storage or History: Nothing is saved on any server. Refreshing or closing the tab permanently clears the session.
  • Strictly 1-to-1 Rooms: Only 2 devices can join a room at a time (a 3rd device is automatically blocked).
  • Both Devices Must Stay Open: Because transfers happen directly peer-to-peer, both browser tabs must remain open until the transfer completes.
  • Strict Firewalls: Some restrictive campus or corporate Wi-Fi networks (Symmetric NAT) may block direct peer-to-peer connections.
